verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Sprinto serves an llms.txt documentation index at docs.sprinto.com (HTTP 200). A second probe confirms Markdown versions of the docs pages that point back to that index, so an agent can be directed at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt or other agent-specific guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
